tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: Discover available bioinformatics plotting modules by purpose or data features. Return summaries and suitability; empty keyword browses pages. Entries with available=false are for introduction only and cannot be executed. / 查找生信模块，available=false仅供介绍，不能执行。

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Find website usage guidance and common troubleshooting answers by keyword or FAQ ID. Load only when needed. / 按关键词或编号查询网站使用说明及常见问题，按需读取。

tools.name: get_module_demo
tools.description: Get configured example image/page links and a reading guide; no plotting occurs. Examples are not results for the user's data; missing links are not invented. / 获取已配置的示例图片、页面链接及读图说明，不执行绘图、不编造链接。

tools.name: get_module_schema
tools.description: Read a module's TSV input format, column meanings, example, parameter aliases, defaults and constraints. Read once before drawing; full FAQ is optional. Use inputs for multi-input modules. / 查询模块数据格式、列含义、示例、参数别名、默认值和约束，完整问答按需加载。

tools.name: draw_plot
tools.description: Submit one TSV dataset for serial background plotting. accepted is not completion; poll get_result. One job globally, at most one new admission per 5s. busy/rate_limited are not admitted: wait and retry the same ID. / 提交一份TSV后台绘图，accepted不是完成；全局单任务且每5秒最多受理一次，忙碌或限频均未受理，等待后原编号重试。

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Check an existing drawing request's status and file links within the current key's result scope. Use after timeouts; do not submit a duplicate task. / 查询当前密钥结果范围内原任务的状态和文件链接，超时先查询，不重复提交。
